svg.title: Three panels, one per neuron. Each window's mean activation appears as a dot, and a running mean settles on a flat line, the neuron's baseline. A diamond marks the neuron's value on our prompt, at the token where it is furthest from the baseline, which is far outside the range it takes on the corpus.
